description: Roll out cluster autoscaler on a 50-node EKS cluster with mixed on-demand + spot node groups. Must: install cluster-autoscaler via Helm, configure node group auto-discovery, set min/max node counts per group, tune scale-down delay to 10 minutes, verify scale-up triggers on pending pods, verify scale-down drains nodes gracefully, and monitor for pod disruption. Risk factors: scale-down killing nodes with non-reschedulable pods (PDB violations), spot interruption during scale-down, autoscaler thrashing between scale-up and scale-down. Tools available: Helm, kubectl, aws CLI, Prometheus, Grafana.
